description: Georgia Habitat and Restoration Interactive Maps is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Georgia Department of Natural Resources Coastal Resources Division. Explore interactive maps showing locations and details of reef restoration projects. Details of each reef include the depth, materials used, and the regulations attached to the reef. You can also find booklets with historical summaries and PDF files detailing the inshore and offshore reef projects. Downloadable files contain the coordinates of Georgia’s Offshore Artificial Reefs. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
